headline: Ten days from the conference opener, the GSC has seventeen matches behind it and a table that still reads all zeros.
dek: UAH have scored eight goals, more than any other GSC programme, and have won both matches they have played. Five matches whose dates have passed carry no published result.

summary_stat.label: Matches played
summary_stat.detail: Seventeen matches carry a final with a published score. All seventeen were played against programmes outside the conference, and conference play opens on September 11, ten days after this data was collected.

pattern.label: derived
pattern.text: UAH have scored eight goals and conceded one.

chart.caption: Goals scored by programme across all matches played, through September 1.

findings.label: derived
findings.text: Seven different UAH players have scored this season: Alejandro Tocino Vidal, Emil Wigren, Luis McCabe, Nick Morrow, Oli Orzechowski, Oliver Rigby and Samuel Quickfall.

findings.label: derived
findings.text: Against programmes outside the conference, GSC sides have won seven matches, drawn three and lost seven.

findings.label: observed
findings.text: Five matches whose dates have passed carry no published result, and not one final carries an empty score.

findings.label: observed
findings.text: Two played matches have a published scoreline but no box score, and both are Mississippi Christian's.

findings.label: observed
findings.text: Lee have yet to play a match this season; their season opens in conference play, at AUM on September 12.

last_match.line: West Alabama lost 0-2 at home to Texas A&M International. They have played two matches, a draw and a defeat.

next_match.line: Delta State visit Ouachita Baptist at 15:30. They have played two matches, winning one and losing one.

table_state.statement: No GSC programme has played a conference match, so the table is level and ordered alphabetically. Conference play opens on September 11, ten days after this data was collected.
table_state.footnote: Form strings show non-conference results only. Lee and Spring Hill have played no matches, and their form reads as a dash.

validation.policy: observed and derived claims are recomputed against the data home before publish; failures are dropped, not softened. signal and projected pass on schema unless the data contradicts a figure. context is never validated as a finding.
